on_screen_text.text: Trump's economy is being described as a disaster 😬
VOTERS EXPRESS ANGER, FRUSTRATION, HELPLESSNESS AT RISING COSTS

spoken_summary: A reporter asks people to describe the state of the American economy in one word. One man replies, "I can only think of disaster." Another man states, "Everything's gone up... everything but my paycheck." A woman adds that it feels like "pinching pennies than being able to save."
audio_music: The audio consists solely of dialogue from news interview clips, with ambient background noise from the outdoor settings. There is no music.
editing_pacing: A montage of news clips with quick cuts between different speakers. Animated, word-by-word yellow text overlays highlight the spoken dialogue.
central_claim: The economy under Donald Trump is a disaster for ordinary Americans, who are struggling with rising costs and stagnant wages.
intended_effect: To persuade viewers that Donald Trump's economic policies have failed and to generate negative sentiment towards his presidency.
